run_falign_language_id_reranking: run the falign script to compute ASR alignment scores for language identification reranking
run_wav2vec2_ctc_inference: run Wav2Vec2 CTC model inference on audio files to extract token emission probabilities
run_falign_alignment_scoring: run falign alignment scoring between audio emissions and token sequences using falign_ext
run_asr_score_generation: run the script to generate uasr_score output file with alignment scores per hypothesis
run_audio_token_alignment: run audio-to-token alignment using librosa loading and Wav2Vec2 processor with falign
